scope: Core 51 feature source/scope/flow/state mapping review, plus declared artifact existence snapshot. Not independent pixel-art acceptance.

playerFacingCopy.semantics: blocked=true forbids the original operation; action is a safe alternate or return destination. danger=true is a risk confirmation with cancel. No blocked condition is accepted merely because an image exists.

independentArtAcceptance: Do not infer passed from rendered or file existence. Refer to independent art validation and per-feature acceptance status.

notApplicableReviewed.title: 联网账号登录与注册
notApplicableReviewed.reason: 该源码的主菜单直接创建/读取本地世界与人物，没有MMORPG账户登录流程；可选map sharing不等于账户大厅。

notApplicableReviewed.title: MMORPG服务器选择
notApplicableReviewed.reason: 世界列表是本地世界管理，不是网络区服列表。

notApplicableReviewed.title: 充值与付费货币商城
notApplicableReviewed.reason: 未在研究到的玩家核心功能中发现充值或付费货币；NPC交易由advanced清单覆盖，不换成充值商店。

notApplicableReviewed.title: 玩家邮箱、好友与世界聊天
notApplicableReviewed.reason: NPC对话/阵营/任务适用，但不据此创造MMORPG玩家社交系统。

notApplicableReviewed.title: 签到、抽卡与限时运营领取
notApplicableReviewed.reason: 成就/统计适用，但没有将运营签到或抽卡作为本体功能的源码依据。

notApplicableReviewed.title: 内置热更新下载器
notApplicableReviewed.reason: 官方源码主菜单未提供客户端更新器；外置发行/启动器的下载不属于已核实本体UI，可作为建议扩充分列，不能标已有。

notApplicableReviewed.title: 跨地区远程公共仓库
notApplicableReviewed.reason: 高级物品界面在周边地面/载具/角色容器之间转移，不能替换成不受空间约束的公共仓库。
